title: A flow install announces its raw dep key to the user
description: js/shell/notificationService.js resolves a completed download's display name through MODELS then PLUGINS then falls back to data.modelId, so a flow install toasts 'flow:voice-changer installed.' and sends the same raw key as the OS notification body when the window is unfocused. MPI-310 added the PLUGINS clause for the identical plugin leak; flows (MPI-304) were never added. Third entity through the same chain, so the fix needs a guard test that fails when a fourth is added without a clause.
